title: MonetizeKit stage gate configuration
description: Declares, per stage branch, the observing loops whose verdict on the stage head must hold before the stage may be promoted. Evaluated by scripts/stage-gate/evaluate.mjs, which publishes one `Stage Gate / <stage>` check run on the stage SHA.

base.description: The branch this stage promotes into; drift-clear ranges are `base..<stage head>`.

loop.description: The peripheral loop this signal represents, as named in the roadmap loop inventory.

required.description: false = advisory: reported in the summary, never moves the conclusion (shadow mode).

repo.description: OWNER/REPO to read from; defaults to the repository being gated.

name.description: Exact check run (job) name expected on the stage SHA.

workflow.description: Path of the workflow whose job produces this check run. The check run is honored only when it binds to a job of a run of exactly this workflow, from this repository's own code, for the stage SHA — a job of the same name in any other workflow does not count.
Workflow file name in the target repository. Only runs of exactly `.github/workflows/<workflow>` count.

branch.description: Branch the observer's runs must come from; defaults to the target repository's default branch. A run of the same file from any other branch (a stub on a feature branch) does not count.

maxAgeHours.description: A completed run older than this means the loop is not observing the stage.

afterHead.description: Require the run to have started after the stage head landed (one soak cycle).

absent.description: What a loop with no recent run means: pending blocks; skip records `not observing` and does not block (for schedules gated by a repository variable).

workflow.description: Path, in `repo`, of the workflow whose job produces `check`; bound exactly like a check-run signal.
